facts.config_reference_missing: ConfigMap {configmap} was not found in the namespace.
facts.config_reference_present: ConfigMap {configmap} exists (its content is not read), so the problem is more likely a missing key.

steps.step_check_configmap_key: Check that ConfigMap {configmap} has the key the container asks for (Kubron does not read ConfigMap content).

missing.config_unverified: Whether the referenced ConfigMap exists could not be checked ({reason}).
